Box-Cox profile likelihood of a design

Source: R/assumptions.R
box_cox.Rd

Profile log-likelihood of the Box-Cox power lambda for the model of the design, its maximum, the 95 % interval and the nearest conventional power (-1, -0.5, 0, 0.5, 1 or 2).

Usage

box_cox(fit, lambda = seq(-2, 2, by = 0.1))

Arguments

fit

An "ad_anova" object from design_anova().

lambda

Grid of powers.

Value

A list with the profile (profile), the estimate (lambda), the 95 % interval (lower, upper), the nearest conventional power (rounded) and whether the interval contains 1 (contains_one); NULL when the response has zeros or negative values.

Examples

fit <- design_anova(tomato_factorial, "Yield_kg_plant", c("Variety", "Fertilizer"),
                    block = "Block")
box_cox(fit)[c("lambda", "lower", "upper", "rounded")]
#> $lambda
#> [1] 0.2
#> 
#> $lower
#> [1] 0.1
#> 
#> $upper
#> [1] 0.4
#> 
#> $rounded
#> [1] 0
#>
